Build a flowWorkspace GatingSet from a gated SingleCellExperiment

Source: R/gatingset_export.R
gatelabGatingSet.Rd

The samples and events of sce as a GatingSet, with the populations the app stored at the last "Save to SCE" written to its hierarchy: a rectangle, polygon or ellipse drawn in the space the object's transforms give becomes that flowWorkspace gate, a negated gate a negated node, and any other population its exact per-sample membership. Each gate written is recomputed by flowWorkspace and replaced by the membership if it selected other events, so every node holds the events the app showed. The channels are transformed as the object states (gatelabTransforms), and the GateLab workspace is carried as a keyword, so launchGatingApp() on the result opens the same workspace.

Usage

gatelabGatingSet(
  sce,
  assay = NULL,
  hierarchy = NULL,
  sample_column = NULL,
  allow_stale = FALSE
)

Arguments

sce

A SingleCellExperiment saved from the app with "Save to SCE".

assay

The assay to take the events from: by default the one the workspace was drawn from, which for an assay in arcsinh units is put back to nominal linear values through the cofactor the app used, as the app does.

hierarchy

Which hierarchy to write (NULL means the active one).

sample_column

The colData column that defines samples, as for launchGatingApp.

allow_stale

Write memberships whose workspace revision is behind the stored workspace.

Value

A GatingSet, invisibly; a message says which populations went as gates and which as memberships. flowWorkspace is required.
